summary: Bitzero Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Material Change Report disclosing board changes effective June 4, 2026: director Gilles Seguin resigned (remaining Corporate Secretary), and Guido Contesso and Selena Barrera were appointed as directors; Mohammed Bakhashwain was appointed Chair of the Board. No stake, price, or premium is involved; the filing reports governance changes, not a transaction. The non-US report is mapped to a current report on Form 6-K. No terms or advisors are named. What to watch: any subsequent strategic shifts under the new chair, though no immediate event risk.
